_comment: Run-time settings for the XR Guild Hall V3. Edit inside the VIVERSE upload zip (or dist/) without rebuilding; a blank value or 0 keeps the build-time setting from .env. Nothing here is secret: it ships to every visitor. Optional keys: photonMaxPlayers, viverseRoomCap (numbers). See V3.md.

media._comment: tokenUrl = your deployed proxy/media-token-worker.js. Empty = HLS links only, no live screenshare or RTMP.
